name: Animated Blood amalgam deals owner-level damage with Blood Strikes (#7428)
contract: #7428: the Animated Blood amalgam (315301) hits for ~3 at level 41, expected ~60-70. Cause: the template is level 1 and nothing ever scales the summon - TempSummon::InitStats sets owner level only for triggers, and no CoA code touched these entries, so the pet swings with level-1 weapon damage. Fix: bloodmage_blood_constructor scales the brood on summon (owner level, weapon min level x1.0 / max x1.5, attack power from intellect and shadow spell power x0.4, owner hit chances), the Necromancer-minion pattern. The level-1 dummy makes every swing land deterministically (no ratings needed) while keeping pre/post totals an order apart: pre-fix ~15 player + ~15 pet, post-fix ~15 player + ~250 melee + ~280 Blood Strikes. The player stops attacking right after engaging so only the pet damages during the window; owner-in-combat at summon time is what makes the pet engage its victim. Fails pre-fix (drop under 120).
